scope: Additive, explicitly experimental registration of the record VALUES emitted only by the EXPERIMENTAL variant v0.6-a2x (A second attempt). It is not a release, not an entry of the public semantic.v2 changelog and not a new revision: SEMANTIC_V2_REVISION stays 5, SEMANTIC_V2_EMITTED_REVISION has no entry for this model, the checked-in baseline schemas/algotrader.semantic.v2.json and every frozen contract are unchanged. This file is not part of the variant's rules manifest or register, so the v0.6 and v0.6-a2x identities (rules/register hashes, record and scenario ids) are those of 048bf2d. Publication would require a Director-approved semantic.v2 revision with its own changelog entry.

base_contract.kind_contracts: KIND_CONTRACTS_V6 (= KIND_CONTRACTS_V5), unchanged: no kind, field, type or shape is added; only string values and string keys of the open dict fields (observation.values, scenario.setup) are new

value_encoding: Every observation value and every added setup value is an exact string or null: decimals as exact decimal strings in the real price domain (direction applied), instants as ISO-8601 UTC with +00:00 offset (the envelope keeps its Z instants), booleans as "true"/"false", counts and the cursor as decimal integer strings.

roles.first_attempt: The ordinary A scenario (attempt 1) whose CONFIRMED state ends TERMINAL INVALIDATED V_CONTACT; its scenario, child and call records are exactly v0.6 (no added setup key; its terminal record still says discovery_owner RELEASED, as v0.6). Its scenario_id is the impulse_id.
roles.reservation: Not a record kind and not a scenario: the open review of one failed impulse, published only by structure/a_second_attempt observations (decision_role A_SECOND_ATTEMPT_RESERVATION). Its internal token <impulse_id>#review is the discovery owner in the core state and appears in records only as ORDINARY_BIRTH_DEFERRED.values.reserved_by; it is never a scenario, entry-attempt, call or envelope lineage id.
roles.successor: The single distinct second-attempt scenario (attempt 2) of the impulse, with its own scenario_id, child and call.

observation.name: a_second_attempt
observation.envelope: clock_time = known_at = published_at = the dispatch; event_start/event_end null; subject = lineage[0]

REVIEW_OPEN.meaning: The confirmed first attempt failed at its V before the original expiry and every admissibility condition held: the same-direction discovery slot is reserved for one second attempt (not a scenario, entry or call).

REVIEW_NOT_OPENED.meaning: The confirmed first attempt failed at its V but a second attempt is not admissible; v0.6 behaviour (owner released). The first unmet condition is the reason.

reasons.EVALUATION_TAIL: the failure is in the evaluation tail
reasons.DISCOVERY_OWNER_ALREADY_RELEASED: the impulse no longer held the discovery owner
reasons.DESTINATION_CONTACT_IN_FAILURE_DISPATCH: a bar admitted in the failure dispatch reached B
reasons.PREMISE_CLOSE_AT_OR_BEYOND_A_PLUS_Z_KNOW: a complete 15m close at/beyond A+z known since the confirmation, that dispatch included
reasons.CONTEXT_OR_ADVERSE_EXPANSION: the ordinary A gate is contrary at tf; suffix :<1h context>/<15m phase>:<expansion direction> (a non-concordant 1h context, or an EXPANSION adverse to the direction)

REVIEW_CLOSED.meaning: The reserved second attempt ended without a successor; the discovery slot is released and the ordinary latch applies from that dispatch.
REVIEW_CLOSED.reason_format: <code>[:<detail>]: REQUIRED_INPUT_STALE:TRADE_15M; REQUIRED_GAP_15m:<gap record id>:<status>; REQUIRED_MONITORING_GAP:<gap>; DESTINATION_CONTACT[_TIME_AMBIGUOUS]:<1m bar id>; CONTEXT_OR_ADVERSE_EXPANSION:<1h context>/<15m phase>:<expansion direction>

SUCCESSOR_ARMED.meaning: A fresh complete post-failure reaction qualified: the single successor of the impulse is armed (budget consumed, no third attempt). The successor's own ARM scenario record follows in the same dispatch.

ORDINARY_BIRTH_DEFERRED.meaning: An ordinary same-direction Q_A true while the slot is reserved (review or successor): no ordinary birth now. Published once per reservation (the counter keeps every deferral).

RECOVERY_EXCLUDED_INSUFFICIENT_RESIDUAL.meaning: Ratified precision 1: a successor recovery with less than the A minimum residual before H0, recorded with its exclusion; not confirmed, not operational, no extension. The successor then ends EXPIRED.

reasons.INSUFFICIENT_RESIDUAL: fixed value of values.reason; values.operational is always "false"

scenario.successor_id: A<L|S>-<anchor 15m bar start>-<hash(rules_sha256, instrument, 'A2', direction, impulse_id, anchor bar id)> (ordinary births: A<L|S>-<source bar start>-<hash(rules_sha256, instrument, 'A', direction, bar id)>)

setup_keys_added.attempt: "2" on every successor record; absent on every first-attempt (ordinary) record
setup_keys_added.formation_origin: O, the first 15m boundary at/after tf
setup_keys_added.failed_attempt_R: frozen R of the failed first attempt (real price domain)

scenario.renewal: SECOND_ATTEMPT (setup.renewal of the successor; ordinary births keep FIRST_ASSESSABLE_TRUE / FALSE_AT_OR_AFTER_RELEASE_TO_TRUE)
scenario.inherited: Every other transition, reason and field of the successor is the v0.6 vocabulary (REVISE/REARM before confirmation, CONFIRM, INVALIDATED V_CONTACT, DESTINATION_REACHED, STALLED, TIME_EXPIRED, OWNER_RELEASE / EXPIRED ORIGINAL_SETUP_DEADLINE ...); original_expiry and confirmed_deadline equal H0.

entry_attempt.values_added: none: the successor's child uses the v0.6 vocabulary; clocks.hard_deadline = H0

hard_deadline_origin_added.ORIGINAL_IMPULSE_EXPIRY: the successor's call: hard_deadline = H0 (the impulse's original expiry), progress_check_at = issue + (H0 - issue)/2; a first-attempt call keeps STRUCTURAL_CONFIRMATION_PUBLICATION

call.call_revision: unchanged v0.6 vocabulary (lineage = the call id)

synthetic_coverage.note: Category / category:reason-code pairs (REVIEW_CLOSED as category:state:code) exercised by the synthetic tapes of tests/test_a2x_second_attempt.py. Registered values absent here have no dedicated tape; they are reached by code paths shared with v0.6 conditions (tail, expiry, owner, readiness, 15m gap/staleness, ambiguous contact, window end).
